summary: Black Rock Coffee Bar filed an 8-K disclosing entry into an irrevocable proxy with certain Class C common shareholders (Founder Investors) granting the company and its CEO voting power over Covered Shares for up to two years, alongside an amendment to registration rights increasing Cynosure Investors' demand requests from three to four, and termination of the Cynosure Voting Agreement. No price, stake, or premium stated; no board recommendation or advisor named. The proxy appears to consolidate control ahead of potential governance shifts. Watch for any related stockholder actions or further control transactions, though near-term risk-arb is absent as no deal is announced.
